summary.text: Darnell Brewer is a Democratic state representative from Ohio who represents District 22 and is running unopposed in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Darnell Brewer earned a B.A. in urban studies, with a minor in communications and a certificate in nonprofit management, from Cleveland State University, and a master of legal studies from the Cleveland-Marshall College of Law.

Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as a social service coordinator and says he joined the executive committee of the Cleveland chapter of the NAACP, the National Association of Community Health Workers, the Carl Stokes Brigade, the Southern Christian Leadership Council, and the National Action Network.
Brewer assumed office in the Ohio House on January 1, 2025, and is ranking member of the Community Revitalization Committee and a member of the Children and Human Services Committee.
